basics.name: Anushree Ganta
basics.label: Frontend Developer
basics.summary: Frontend Developer with technical expertise in designing, developing, and optimizing high-performance web applications. Skilled in modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems, HTML5/CSS3, React, state management frameworks, UI component architecture, and REST/GraphQL API integration. Passionate about building responsive, accessible, and user-centric web applications with emphasis on web performance, cross-browser compatibility, and modern design systems.

work.name: eDiligence
work.summary: Engineered interactive data visualization dashboards and modular client-side architectures to track real-time agile development metrics.
highlights: Architected an interactive Agile analytics platform using React.js, Redux, and D3.js, visualizing complex sprint velocity and project telemetry with dynamic chart rendering.
Designed component-driven UI library leveraging Material-UI (MUI), React Router, and CSS3, establishing responsive design templates and single-page application (SPA) routing.
Built a high-performance Node.js & Express REST API tier integrated with MongoDB, implementing NoSQL schema optimization for low-latency data retrieval.
Optimized client-side rendering and state hydration, tuning React component render cycles to ensure 60fps animation performance.

work.name: Accenture Pvt. Ltd.
work.summary: Spearheaded frontend feature development, UI component modularization, and web performance optimization for enterprise eCommerce platforms.
highlights: Engineered interactive analytics dashboards in React.js featuring customizable drag-and-drop UI components and CSS3 Flexbox/Grid layouts, boosting user productivity.
Optimized enterprise eCommerce frontend web applications using modern JavaScript (ES6+), Core-JS polyfills, and jQuery, resolving cross-browser compatibility and legacy code bottlenecks.
Implemented Real User Monitoring (RUM) and client-side performance telemetry using Boomerang.js, analyzing Core Web Vitals to optimize page load speeds by 25%.
Standardized automated CI/CD frontend build and deployment workflows using Jenkins and npm, accelerating release cycles and automated test execution.

projects.name: RecallExplain AI
projects.description: An AI-powered search recall diagnostics and explainability tool built using LangGraph.
highlights: Architected a multi-agent LangGraph workflow to trace, analyze, and explain item retrieval paths within recommendation engines.
Designed semantic search tracing and query-intent explanation tools, reducing query-to-item recommendation debugging times for backend engineers.

projects.name: Docker Failover & Load Balancing Engine
projects.description: A dynamic container orchestration system to automate resource scaling and failover recovery.
highlights: Architected a Java-based container monitoring daemon that detects CPU/memory exhaustion and dynamically reallocates Docker containers.
Implemented threshold-based load-balancing algorithms to achieve zero-downtime container migration during node failure simulations.

projects.name: Hybrid Curation & Recommendation System
projects.description: A personalized food curation and recommendation platform based on nutritional profiles and preferences.
highlights: Engineered a recommendation engine that processes user nutritional data to output real-time personalized meal configurations.
Designed and deployed a mobile client with local data syncing, allowing offline rule evaluation and low-latency rendering.

key_differentiators.summary: Why hire me as a Frontend Developer

points.detail: I design and build intuitive, scalable, and modular web applications using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks. By leveraging component-driven architecture and design systems, I deliver maintainable frontend code bases.

I specialize in optimizing web applications for fast load times, smooth interactions, and accessibility. By tuning bundle sizes, rendering paths, and Core Web Vitals, I ensure exceptional user experiences.
I bridge frontend user interfaces with complex backend ecosystems, engineering robust client-side state management, async data fetching, and real-time UI updates.
